يحتميا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَمِيَا (yaḥtamiyā) /jaħ.ta.mi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
# يُحْتَمَيَا (yuḥtamayā) /juħ.ta.ma.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَمَى (iḥtamā)
